title: 9 Lies This Culture Sold You About a Godly Man's Work
caption:
The paycheck was never the whole job. This culture sold you a version of "providing" that fits neatly on a resume and asks nothing of your presence, your rest, or your family's dinner table.

Scripture asks for more than the deposit. Save this before you build your whole identity on the wrong nine lies.
